topic: The Fire Sheep year (2027) favors love but tests money and work: the Sheep spends, a double fire year tempts risk, people at work will be sensitive. One word for money: caution.
phrases: Walk away first. Say it later.
Passion is a double-edged sword at work.

images.concept: A woman closing her notebook at dawn over tidy receipts: calm control of money.
images.prompt: A cinematic photograph of a woman seen from behind at a wooden desk at dawn, closing a leather notebook over a neat stack of receipts, a cup of tea steaming beside her. Soft window light in antique gold, the room in deep midnight jade shadow. Quiet, deliberate, in control. No watermarks or Western zodiac imagery anywhere in the image.

images.concept: A single coin balanced on the edge of a ledger: caution made visible.
images.prompt: A still life photograph: an old brass coin balanced upright on the edge of an open ledger book on a dark wood table, a fountain pen beside it, warm lamp light in antique gold against a deep plum background. Tension and balance. No watermarks or Western zodiac imagery anywhere in the image.

images.concept: Text card with the week's money line.
images.prompt: An elegant typographic image on a deep midnight jade background with a subtle linen texture. Centered text in refined serif lettering, antique gold: "Not scared. Careful." Spell every word perfectly. No watermarks or Western zodiac imagery anywhere in the image.

images.concept: A professional woman stepping out into a corridor to breathe instead of firing back.
images.prompt: A cinematic photograph of a woman in business clothes seen from behind, stepping out of a glass-walled meeting room into a quiet sunlit corridor, one hand on the door, head slightly lifted as if taking a breath. Warm golden light, soft sage plants along the corridor. No watermarks or Western zodiac imagery anywhere in the image.

images.concept: An empty office chair pushed back by a window: someone just walked away to cool off.
images.prompt: A calm photograph of an office window at golden hour, an empty chair pushed back from a desk as if someone just stepped away for air, a jacket on the chair back, warm antique gold light across the desk. No watermarks or Western zodiac imagery anywhere in the image.
